item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i thugs sgrub gzhung zab mo ye shes rang gsal zab mo ye shes rang gsal
item.coloph: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo yi/ thugs kyi bsgrub (sgrub) pa zab mo 'di/ gang zhig gshen po gang dag gis/ nyams su blang pa'i yon tan ni/ gzhal med dpag med brjod du med/ 'gal rkyen bar chad kun zhi zhing /nad dang gdon gyis mi tshug par/ mdo sngags sa lam yon tan thob/ rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin 'grub/ dam ldan gshen gyi man ngag go dam med rnams la gsang rgya mdzod/ bstan pa'i srog mkhar tshug par shog de ltar ye shes dbal mo nyid/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ci bzhin du/ nges med rnal 'byor tshul 'dzin pos/ yi ge ris su bkod pa la/ nyes 'gal ci mchis lha la bshags/ dge mchis mkha' mnyam sems can kun/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu gyur cig sa ma ya// rgya rgya rgya//
